_comment: Things met on the road that are not (at first) a fight. where: road (true = only on roads, false = only off them, missing = either), biomes (or ["any"]), danger [min, max], time any/day/night, season list or any. Each option has a label and one of: outcome, check (skill, dc, success, failure) or shop (stock [item, qty], markup). Outcomes: text (one is chosen; {name} is the leader), items [[item, qty or dice]] (negative qty = given away), money (copper; negative = paid), xp, deed, news (true: hear of a place you don't know), fatigue (change), effect [name, hours], loot [[item, dice, chance]], fight (an encounter group), ambush [group, chance], time (minutes). requires: items [[item, qty]] and/or money.

pedlar.name: a travelling pedlar
intro: A pedlar comes the other way, bent under a pack twice his width, a cudgel through his belt. He raises a hand: friendly, careful.
A woman leading a laden mule has stopped by the road to rest it. She looks you over and decides you might be customers.

options.label: See what there is to buy

text: The talk is of prices, tolls and weather, and then, lower: of a place you did not know about.
You nod and walk on.

pilgrims.name: pilgrims
intro: A file of pilgrims in grey wool trudges along the verge, singing badly. Their leader carries a staff hung with little bells.
Five pilgrims sit by a milestone, sharing a loaf. One waves you over.

text: They share bread and gossip, and ask nothing of you. It is the easiest mile in weeks.
The leader blesses you in a language you do not know. It sounds sincere.
You leave them to their singing.

patrol.name: a patrol
intro: Four spearmen and a sergeant on a tired horse block the road. "Where from, and where to?"
A patrol in the lord's colours waves you to the side of the road. They look bored and underpaid.

text: The sergeant grunts, waves you on, and as you pass mentions trouble further on.
They do not like your answers. They go through your pack and keep a "road toll" for their trouble.

options.label: Ask them about the dangers hereabouts

text: "Stay on the road," says the sergeant, and tells you why.
Coin changes hands. Suddenly everyone is friends, and the sergeant has a great deal to say about the country ahead.

refugees.name: refugees
intro: A cart with a broken wheel, and around it a family: two children, a grandmother, a man with his arm in a sling. Everything they own is on the cart.
People on the road with bundles and handcarts, faces grey with tiredness, all going the same way: away.

text: The children eat as if they had forgotten how. The grandmother holds your hand and will not let go for a while.
The man takes it without a word, then turns away so you won't see his face.
Raiders, soldiers, it hardly matters which: the village is ash. They tell you where, and whom to avoid.
You walk on. They do not call after you.

wounded_traveller.name: a wounded traveller
intro: A man sits against a tree, grey-faced, his hands pressed to his side. There is a lot of blood on the grass.
A woman lies by the roadside, one leg twisted under her. She has been there a while.

text: You stop the bleeding and get water into them. Later, they press a few coins on you and will not take them back.
You do what you can. It is not enough. They die holding your sleeve.
failure.deed: tried to save a dying stranger

text: They watch you do it. Neither of you says anything.
You walk on. The sound follows you further than it should.

abandoned_camp.name: an abandoned camp
intro: A cold fire-pit, a torn lean-to, scattered belongings. Whoever camped here left in a hurry, or didn't leave at all.
Somebody's camp, a few days old: tracks everywhere, a smashed pot, a bedroll kicked into the bushes.

text: Under the lean-to and in the bushes you find what the owners never came back for.
You turn over the mess for half an hour and find nothing worth carrying.
Whatever happened here, you don't need it to happen to you.

hunters.name: hunters
intro: Two hunters with a deer slung on a pole between them stop to look you over.
A trapper with a string of pelts over one shoulder falls into step beside you.

text: They tell you, more or less. Hunters never tell you everything.
They watch you go, then carry on.

carcass.name: a fresh carcass
intro: A deer lies dead in the grass, throat torn, barely touched. Whatever killed it will be back.
The carcass of an elk, killed within the hour. Crows are gathering but nothing else has come yet.

text: You work fast and cut away good meat.
You make a mess of it and save little.
You leave it to whatever killed it.

shrine.name: a wayside shrine
intro: A little stone shrine stands at the crossroads, its saint worn faceless by weather. Someone has left fresh flowers and a few coins.
A wooden shrine on a post, roofed with bark. Inside: a carved figure, candle stubs, and offerings.

text: For a few minutes the world is quiet. You feel steadier when you stand.
You add your coin to the others.
outcome.deed: left an offering at a shrine

text: A handful of copper and a cheap brass ring. Nobody saw. Probably.

herbs.name: a patch of herbs
intro: In a sheltered hollow, a patch of plants you half recognise: yarrow, comfrey, perhaps woundwort.

text: You pick the right ones and bundle them carefully.
You are not sure which are which, and leave them rather than guess.
You walk on.

hungry_deserters.name: hungry deserters
intro: Three men in stained soldiers' coats step out of the trees. They have weapons but they look more hungry than dangerous. "Food," one says. "Please."

text: They eat standing up, like dogs. Then they nod, and go back into the trees.
They look at you, and at each other, and decide you are not worth it.
"Wrong answer," says the one in front, and they draw.
You draw. So do they.

gibbet.name: a gibbet
intro: A gibbet at the crossroads, and in it what is left of a man. A board nailed below says what he did.
Two bodies hang from the old oak by the road, turning slowly. The crows have been at them.

text: Banditry on the king's road, it says, and names where. The lord wants the rest of them found.

options.label: Cut them down and bury them

text: It takes an hour. Nobody thanks you, and somebody may mind.
outcome.deed: buried the hanged at a crossroads

text: You walk on, not looking up.
